A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("Beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>Alpha</a>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
